lines.x: Brent crude oil prices fell 5% to $91 per barrel this week as recovering crude flows from the Middle East Gulf to Asian buyers offset tanker attacks and escalating regional tensions.
European equity benchmarks closed lower on Wednesday, with the Stoxx 600 dropping 1% and major national indexes falling across London, Frankfurt, Paris, and Milan.
Gold prices recorded their worst weekly slide in eight months, with Dubai retail gold falling 19 dirhams to 13-month lows, pressured by dollar strength and rising bets on Federal Reserve tightening.
Copper prices dropped to their lowest levels since March following a weekly market decline driven by investor worries over global industrial consumption.
